reviews.text:
God forbid you ever land on their marketing list. My dog passed away over 2 years ago and no matter how many times I tell them, they still keep texting me messages like:

"Hey human! Moose reached out a while back"

How traumatized to keep getting fake messages from your dead dog to remind you that they wanted a discount on grooming... Disgusting!

What an amazing team! My pup Gordon did a complete 180 after joining their 3 week training program. He's a lot more confident and doesn't pull on the leash as much and is waaay less reactive in general. His personality is really shining through now and I feel like I finally know who my pup actually is. Matt's a really great teacher, not just to Gordon, but to me as well. After the program, I also feel a lot more confident in my role in Gordon's life and the things I need to do to make sure he has the structure and stability he needs to grow into a healthy and happy dog. Can't recommend them enough!

I brought my dog to Whitaker dog thinking it would help him with his anxiety, socialization, and obedience. It did for about a week after the program and maybe two weeks later he was right back to normal. No clear instructions were given to help keep up his behavior and we were told we would have to pay to help fix it? I don’t know but I’m disappointed O really thought this program would help but it didn’t. Feels like a slap in the face being that he was gone for nearly 4 weeks.

They absolutely transformed my dog! At 6 years old, I was unsure whether it was too late to train her as she was anxious, hyperactive, and a bit bossy. After doing the 4 week board-and-train, she was like a different dog. It took a lot of follow through and commitment at home, but I couldn’t be more impressed by the Whitaker team and more proud of my girl for all she learned. Their continued support even after she came back home made such a difference, and the pick up/drop off service is a huge bonus. I couldn’t recommend enough!
Thank you for the five stars, Stella! It means a lot to our dog training team in Los Angeles, and we're always here if you have questions as your pup keeps progressing.
Tony, we appreciate the 5-star review! Thanks for choosing Whitaker Dog Training, and we hope your pup is showing off everything they learned.
The best training daycare and boarding ever!!!

I was with my sister the day Whitaker Dog Day Camp lost her dog, Kai, and it was one of the most heartbreaking and stressful experiences I’ve ever witnessed.

For hours, we searched in extreme heat, completely panicked and desperate to find him. As family, Kai isn’t “just a dog” to us he’s loved like family. Watching my sister break down while not knowing if he was safe was absolutely devastating.

What shocked me most was the lack of urgency and compassion shown by the staff. While we were frantically searching, it felt like they had already given up. At one point, we were even encouraged to stop looking and go home. I cannot imagine how anyone could expect us to sleep at night without knowing where our dog was or whether he was hurt.

Eventually, Kai was found injured, terrified, and in need of veterinary care. Seeing him in that condition after hours alone in dangerous temperatures was heartbreaking.

Mistakes can happen, but how a business responds to an emergency says everything. In our experience, there was a serious lack of accountability, urgency, and empathy during one of the most traumatic situations our family has ever faced. I would never trust them with a pet again.

This team is incredible with dogs! My five month old puppy came back after training and no longer playfully bites or jumps, and knows several commands. They are kind gentle trainers who use positive reinforcement to get great results. Can’t recommend highly enough!

Matt and the Whitaker Dog Training program have gone above and beyond to help us. As first time dog owners, we feel so at peace knowing Matt is always a phone call away. Would recommend the training program to any one of my friends and family. Also shout out to Mark in the day care - the best of the best and treats our dog like his own.

Great organization.   Our family has four large k9s.  They are spoiled and opportunists.

They took my dogs in for “rehab” and Matt the dog whisperer used his magic wand to herd.

They customized compassionate approaches for my four dogs and work with me with great patience.

Matt (and the management) treats every living thing with mutual respects, we admire that very much.

Sincerely
Mattea, thank you for the five-star rating! We loved working with your pup through our dog training program and are always happy to help with next steps.
Wouldn’t recommend, was rude over an inquiry and overpriced

I don’t even know where to begin. I left my Milo there for 10 days during the holiday break and I felt like he was truly taken care of. I got picture and email updates constantly. They were so extremely flexible with making a last-minute reservation, updating the reservation, and even setting up a time for me to pick him up when I showed up after they closed. They truly care about ensuring all dogs have a great experience, and I’m so glad I found them. 10/10 recommend!!
I needed my cat Mucca paws trimmed ( an emergency). They took me in right away and took care of him. Lulu was great with him. Thank you for great service.

We’ve boarded our boxer at Whitaker a couple of times and have also done grooming and day care with them. Every time has been fantastic. Our boxer dog comes home tired, happy, and looking fresh. The staff are super friendly and I like that I’m able to check in on him via text. Highly recommend this place!
I was very please on the training that was provided at Whitaker dog training . The videos they provided during the training gave me piece of mind . Thanks Matt and his crew

I had a wonderful experience. They helped my eight month old golden retriever and she is so much better after two weeks and she is when we started. From the initial call to the final drop off everyone has been extremely professional on time and knowledgeable. Matthew made it very easy for me to feel Comfortable giving the leash over for two weeks. I am very glad that I use them and would highly recommend to anybody. Thank you too the whole team!!
Ethan....... Looking forward to helping you

We love Whitaker!! Our dog Winnie absolutely loves going to camp and always comes home happy and exhausted. Whitaker makes our lives so much easier with busy work schedules or sometimes just wanting a regular weekend day without having to be on doggy time. We are especially grateful for Mark, who runs our pickup and drop off route. Mark takes such amazing care of our Winnie and we know she’s in trustworthy hands with him! The photos we get from camp are a bonus too!! Thank you Mark and team!!!
Such an incredibly kind, considerate operation being ran here. I am so impressed and grateful, my saving grace.  My puppy might be more excited to see the team than me !

After rescuing an adorable but unruly puppy from the shelter we knew we needed help with training - luckily we found Whitaker - in 3 weeks we had a fully trained pup and a training for us as well.
Matt was our trainer - thoughtful compassionate, super knowledgeable and effective.
Cannot recommend enough.

We’ve been sending our pup here for over 4 yrs, and it’s been the best! The pick-up and drop-off service makes it so worth it, and on top of that, the guys who look after our dog are just the nicest and sweetest with her! They truly care for her and it makes us feel great leaving her with them. They’re also super responsive and flexible with scheduling. Highly recommend!

My dog has been going to Whitaker for over a year now and he absolutely loves his days there! I also enjoy the fact that they are so flexible and the pick up/drop off makes it so much easier for us. They are so communicative and pleasant to deal with. Highly highly recommend them!

I could not be happier with these wonderful people! Every employee I have met, from the first person to come to my home to assess my dog, to every driver that has come to pick him up, has been conscientious, professional, and do a great job …
This business litters throughout my neighborhood with illegal promotional signs. If a business is so careless to litter like this I wouldn't trust them with my pets.

Everyone has been so caring and helpful in helping to socialize my dog. She hadn't really been around other dogs and she's been having the time of her life at daycare and when she stays overnight with Whitaker Dog Day Camp. I couldn't be more grateful that she's having fun and I get to work without random puppy attacks lol.

We’ve loved Whitaker while living in Echo Park. Our dog can be territorial but was always so so excited whenever he saw the Whitaker van roll up for pickup. The staff are very attentive and accommodating. Couldn’t recommend more!
I am busy, run a non-profit, have a newborn and I am always on the go.  Whitaker Dog has saved us on numerous occasions and I feel horrible that it’s taken me 6 years to write a review lol …
I’ve tried a handful of daycare places and Whitaker is the best. A bit more $, but in the end it’s totally worth it. You pay for what you get. And you can tell they care.
